positions.proposed: 椰枣村
positions.why: Kept from stage 01: Equals the approved event name (events.ts TEXT_ZH name) and the termbase entry Palm Village = 椰枣村.

positions.proposed: 季节性体验
positions.why: Kept from stage 01: Pattern of the TM kicker 季节性湖泊 (delfoon-lake); not rendered today, translated for the record.

positions.proposed: 由哈萨发展管理局、哈萨市政局主办的季节性目的地，坐落在绿洲的椰枣林间，汇集椰枣专卖店、餐厅、咖啡馆、手工艺展馆与椰枣树博物馆。
positions.why: Editor: the colon-list after a long subject read as an English appositive; folded into one verb clause (汇集……与……). Same five items, organisers verbatim.

positions.proposed: 椰枣村是由哈萨发展管理局、哈萨市政局主办的季节性目的地，坐落在哈萨绿洲的椰枣林间。这里礼赞椰枣树及其孕育的一切：椰枣与琳琅满目的椰枣制品、悉心照料椰枣树的农民，还有以棕榈叶编织的手工艺品。购物、品尝与传统文化在此交汇相融。游览可分多站进行，每位访客都能按自己的兴趣和行程时间，挑选合适的站点。
positions.why: Editor: split the overlong second sentence (dash clause became its own sentence); 种类繁多 -> 琳琅满目 (one natural four-character phrase for "many products"); "a visit works as a tour of several stops" rendered as Chinese guidance (游览可分多站进行) instead of the simile 就像一趟多站之旅. No fact added or removed.

positions.proposed: 2024 年 12 月，东部省省长沙特·本·纳伊夫·本·阿卜杜勒阿齐兹王子宣布启动该项目，旨在将其打造为椰枣树与椰枣相关产品及配套活动的常设场所。2025 年 4 月 22 日（星期二）晚，哈萨县县长沙特·本·塔拉勒·本·巴德尔王子主持开幕，场地面积 50000 多平方米。首届恰逢“2025 手工艺年”，设有手工艺人与工作坊专区；当时预计日均访客约 5000 人——这是开幕时公布的预估数字，并非实际到访人数的记录。
positions.why: Editor: 椰枣树和椰枣产品及相关活动 was a noun pile-up; now 椰枣树与椰枣相关产品及配套活动 with 旨在 to carry "as a lasting venue". 预计每天约有 5000 名访客 -> 预计日均访客约 5000 人 (tighter, same number). Title ruling (see notes): office + name + 王子, no 殿下, per house precedent. Dates and 50000 多平方米 unchanged (site form, cf. 12000 多平方米).

positions.proposed: 第二届于 2026 年 1 月 27 日在东部省省长的赞助下开幕，由东部省副省长沙特·本·班达尔·本·阿卜杜勒阿齐兹王子主持，哈萨县县长出席，展期两个月。场地面积 90000 平方米，设有 21 家椰枣及椰枣制品商店、19 家餐厅与咖啡馆、5 家哈萨乡村产品商店，以及 7 座取材于椰枣树的手工艺展馆。活动内容包括：介绍椰枣树、椰枣品种及其历史的椰枣树博物馆，互动剧场，民间艺术，汇集艺术、文学、手工艺与民间传统的文化之家，以及儿童活动。以上数字仅属第二届，各届设施可能有所不同。
positions.why: Localizer/source correction: EN now says "crafts made from the palm" (AR المصنوعة من النخيل); 椰枣树手工艺展馆 was ambiguous (crafts about vs. made of the palm), now 取材于椰枣树的手工艺展馆 = made from, not 编织 (woven). Editor: programme list given a colon and commas between items because one item (文化之家) contains its own 、 list, which made the 01 run-on unreadable. Numbers 21/19/5/7, 90000 and the date unchanged.

positions.proposed: 下一届已确定于 2026 年 11 月举办。确切开幕日期、展期长短、开放时间与费用均尚未公布，出行前请以主办方公告为准。椰枣村的举办场地固定，位于穆巴拉兹的穆海里斯区，地图链接见“游览信息”卡片。建议预留两到三个小时从容游览；在椰枣专卖店选购前，不妨先问清品种、产地与保存方法。
positions.why: Editor: 在穆巴拉兹的穆海里斯区的固定场地举办 stacked two 的; restructured so the approved place string 穆巴拉兹的穆海里斯区 stands verbatim after 位于. 购买 -> 选购 (shopping register). Month/year 2026 年 11 月 = approved form.

positions.proposed: 有意参展的商户、农民、手工艺人和家庭工坊，可通过本页的展位登记链接报名申请展位。

entry.en: Prince Saud bin Nayef bin Abdulaziz (Emir of the Eastern Province)
entry.ar: صاحب السمو الملكي الأمير سعود بن نايف بن عبدالعزيز، أمير المنطقة الشرقية
entry.zh: 东部省省长沙特·本·纳伊夫·本·阿卜杜勒阿齐兹王子
entry.note: Full form extending the bound entry 沙特·本·纳伊夫王子 with 本·阿卜杜勒阿齐兹 (bound 阿卜杜勒阿齐兹). Office before the name, 王子 after (house rule, not 亲王). Emir of a province = 省长 (Chinese press convention for Saudi regional emirs; 东部省 bound). HRH not rendered as a separate honorific. Stage 03 title ruling: confirmed — HRH/HH not rendered (no 殿下 anywhere in src/ or the termbase; published alkoot pages name the same person 沙特·本·纳伊夫王子 bare; mainland press narrative names Saudi princes by office + name without 殿下). The short bound form 沙特·本·纳伊夫王子 stays valid where the office is not stated.

entry.en: Prince Saud bin Talal bin Badr (Governor of Al-Ahsa)
entry.ar: صاحب السمو الأمير سعود بن طلال بن بدر، محافظ الأحساء
entry.zh: 哈萨县县长沙特·本·塔拉勒·本·巴德尔王子
entry.note: Transliteration from the Arabic: سعود = 沙特 (bound), طلال = 塔拉勒, بدر = 巴德尔 (standard Xinhua renderings of Talal/Badr). محافظ الأحساء = 哈萨县县长, derived from bound 哈萨县 (governorate = 县, so its head = 县长; 总督 is reserved in the termbase for historic governors). HH not rendered separately.

entry.en: Prince Saud bin Bandar bin Abdulaziz (Deputy Emir of the Eastern Province)
entry.ar: صاحب السمو الملكي الأمير سعود بن بندر بن عبدالعزيز، نائب أمير المنطقة الشرقية
entry.zh: 东部省副省长沙特·本·班达尔·本·阿卜杜勒阿齐兹王子
entry.note: Transliteration from the Arabic: بندر = 班达尔 (standard Xinhua rendering, e.g. 班达尔·本·苏尔坦); 阿卜杜勒阿齐兹 bound. Deputy Emir = 副省长 (pairs with 省长).

entry.en: Emir of the Eastern Province / Governor of Al-Ahsa (office, without name)
entry.zh: 东部省省长 / 哈萨县县长
entry.note: Offices used alone in body.3 (patron and attendee). Must match the named entries above.
Saudi Ministry of Culture year initiative; semantic rendering in Chinese quotation marks as an official campaign name; 手工艺 consistent with 手工艺人 (approved). Digit-CJK spacing per site convention.
Semantic: النخلة = the date palm = 椰枣树 (bound entry date palm), aligned with 椰枣村. Not 棕榈博物馆 (棕榈 reserved for the formal 棕榈与椰枣 centre names).

entry.note: Hasawi adjective rule (哈萨 + noun); 乡村产品 as in the approved event activity 乡村产品市集.
Follows the Arabic authority; approved precedent in events.ts TEXT_ZH (本地家庭工坊的自制产品). EN source corrected after stage 01 to "home-based producers"; consistent with the existing bound entry 家庭工坊的展位.

entry.ar: أجنحة الحرف اليدوية المصنوعة من النخيل
entry.zh: 取材于椰枣树的手工艺展馆
entry.note: Made from (المصنوعة من), not woven: 取材于 marks the material. Used in body.3 and faq.3.a; palm = 椰枣树 (bound date palm).

notes_to_next_stage: 1) TITLE RULING (HRH/HH): no zh precedent on the site renders HRH/HH — 殿下 does not occur in src/ or the termbase, and the house rule is name + 王子 (not 亲王): 沙特·本·纳伊夫王子, 苏尔坦·本·萨勒曼王子, 穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼王子, 萨阿德王子. Mainland press narrative (Xinhua register) names Saudi princes by office + name, without 殿下. Ruling: keep stage 01 — office first, then full name, then 王子 (东部省省长沙特·本·纳伊夫·本·阿卜杜勒阿齐兹王子 / 哈萨县县长沙特·本·塔拉勒·本·巴德尔王子 / 东部省副省长沙特·本·班达尔·本·阿卜杜勒阿齐兹王子); respect is carried by the office and 王子. The HRH vs HH distinction is not carried, deliberately; adding 殿下 would be the only instance on the site and reads courtly/non-mainland. 2) body.3 follows the corrected EN "made from the palm": 取材于椰枣树的手工艺展馆 (not 编织); faq.3.a aligned. 3) Fixed strings untouched: title 椰枣村; organisers 哈萨发展管理局、哈萨市政局 (summary, body.1, practical.1.value, faq.1.a); place 穆巴拉兹的穆海里斯区 (body.4); month/year 2026 年 11 月 (body.4, practical.0.value, faq.0.a). 4) C21: every digit string in faq.* occurs identically in body/card — 2026 年 11 月; 21/19/5/7; 2024 年 12 月; 2025 年 4 月 22 日; 2026 年 1 月 27 日. 一座 in faq.3.a is a word, not a digit. 5) Localization: no added facts (no photo-spot or family claims beyond the source). Card labels kept from approved keys (时间, 主办单位, 费用, 待确认（信息更新中）); 游览信息 = det.visitInfo. 6) Numbers stay without thousands separators (50000 多平方米, 90000 平方米, 5000) per 12000 多平方米 precedent; note one older page has 10,000 平方米 — stage 05 may confirm the house form. 7) EN body.2 spelling corrected upstream to "Saud bin Nayef" (was Naif); zh already follows the termbase 沙特·本·纳伊夫 (نايف), so no zh change.
